context.transcript:
Thank you for coming to our annual appreciation dinner for XRZ Game Studio employees.
Every year we recognize one employee for hard work and contributions to the development of video gaming.
This year we'd like to recognize Tata Yoshi Soto, our lead application designer.
When Tata Yoshi first joined our company, he surprised us by designing a best-selling game.
It took him two days to create it.
And Tata Yoshi has become well known in the field for his designing abilities.
Last month he gave the opening speech at the Oslo Gaming Conference.
Congratulations Tata Yoshi!
context.transcript_translation:
感谢您参加我们为 XRZ Game Studio 员工举办的年度感恩晚宴。
每年我们都会表彰一位在视频游戏开发方面辛勤工作和做出贡献的员工。
今年，我们想表彰我们的首席应用设计师 Tata Yoshi Soto。
当 Tata Yoshi 初到我们公司时，他设计了一款畅销游戏，让我们感到惊喜。
他花了两天时间就完成了它。
而 Tata Yoshi 因其设计能力在业内声名远播。
上个月他在奥斯陆游戏大会发表了开幕演讲。
恭喜您，Tata Yoshi！
